messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts for API route /v1/generate — error rate jump from 0.4% -> 6.7% over last 3m, page sent to oncall-elena. Autoscaling healthy. Suspected KV/prefix layer.

oncall-elena: seeing the pager, I'm on it. first glance: latency spikes correlate with kv read latency. Digging into read QPS heatmap now.

eng-matt: tagging in. I noticed higher retry rates on kv reads for shard group 'shard-07' ~ 1.2k rps, error mix 502/504/timeout. Could be read amplification from prefetch/repair loop.

eng-sre-jordan: logs show repeated checksum mismatch errors from prefix-cache validation for shard-07: "prefix_checksum != stored_checksum" followed by immediate eviction attempts. That could create a spike of backend reads.

oncall-elena: confirmed in metrics: prefix_cache_eviction_rate on shard-07 jumped x15 in last 2m. Cache-miss ratio for that prefix keyspace is ~92%.

eng-matt: quick plan: 1) disable prefetch/repair worker on shard-07 2) short-circuit reads to bypass prefix cache for affected prefixes 3) increase kv client retry backoff to avoid thundering reads. Any objections?

product-lia: FYI potential customer impact — two enterprise customers on region-eu report timeouts in user-facing flows. Liaisoning w/ CS.

cs-raj: we've opened a ticket for the affected customers, advising degraded performance and no data loss. ETA updates in 15m.

infra-olivia: I can apply the bypass flag at the edge routing layer (route-level override) so only /v1/generate for region-eu hits direct store. Will do if eng approves.

eng-sre-jordan: go ahead with bypass at edge first, that will limit blast radius. Then disable the prefetch workers for the shard. Runbook section: "kv/cache-throttle" — follow the live mitigation steps.

oncall-elena: executing commands now:
```
# mark shard-07 prefix cache degraded, disable prefetch
redwood-admin kv shards set-shard-flag --shard shard-07 --flag disable-prefetch true
# set route override for region-eu generate endpoint to bypass prefix cache
redwood-admin routes update --route /v1/generate --region eu --cache-bypass true
```

eng-matt: I'm increasing kv-client max-retries to 6 -> adding jitter/backoff to reduce synchronized retries. Pushing config.

incident-bot: Incident notes: runbook step applied (edge-bypass), config change (kv-retries) pushed, prefetch disabled on shard-07. Keep monitoring for error rate drop.

oncall-elena: After bypass, 5xx rate reduced from 6.7% -> 2.1% in 45s. Latency p95 down from 1.8s -> 550ms. Still above baseline but trending.

eng-sre-jordan: observed a repair loop in the prefetcher that was re-populating corrupted prefixes; disabling it will allow background reconciliation later with throttled rate. Need to scrub the corrupted prefix metadata.

eng-matt: suggestion: run a metadata consistency check on shard-07 and schedule a throttled prefix repair job, not full-speed. Command:
```
redwood-admin kv repair-prefixes --shard shard-07 --mode throttled --parallelism 2 --since 1h
```

infra-olivia: I'll keep the route override in place until we confirm no more spikes for 30m. Then we can re-enable prefix cache incrementally.

product-lia: any immediate customer-level mitigations we can offer? increased timeouts or retry guidance?

cs-raj: recommend asking impacted customers to retry with exponential backoff; we've pushed an incident message. Offering status updates and priority support.

oncall-elena: rolling status update to #incidents: mitigation in place, partial recovery observed, team performing targeted repairs on shard-07. Next update in 20m or sooner if regress.

eng-sre-jordan: note for postmortem: root suspected to be a stale checksum write during compaction that allowed a small set of prefixes to diverge. Prefetch repair logic amplified reads when eviction detected. We'll include proposed changes: stronger compaction validation, circuit-breaker on prefetch read rate, and faster fallback path.

eng-matt: adding immediate config guard: prefetch worker will now circuit-break if eviction rate > 50% for a shard for > 30s. Will roll out as hotfix to scheduler.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Mitigations applied. monitoring window started.

product-lia: capturing customer impact: two enterprise customers with 5–10% request failures during peak window (~5m). No PII exposed. CS handling comms.

cs-raj: logged impacted customers and sent status. They asked for ETA to full resolution — estimating 2–4 hours for safe, throttled repair and verification.

oncall-elena: handing off to eng-sre-jordan for overnight watch. Please keep route bypass until verification completes. Handoff notes: shard-07 still under repair, prefix-cache disabled for that shard, edge override active, increased retries applied.

eng-sre-jordan: taking handoff. Will monitor error rates and progress on repair job. If errors rise >1% again, will re-evaluate and escalate.

infra-olivia: I'll prepare a short rollback plan to re-enable cache for region-eu: staged un-bypass via canary host group.

eng-matt: capturing commands and incident timeline for postmortem.

incident-bot: Pager closed for oncall-elena (acknowledged, mitigated, handed off). Please file postmortem and link to runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/kv-cache-throttle

eng-sre-jordan: filing a P1 postmortem draft now, will include logs and timeline.

cs-raj: will follow up with customers with the ETA and postmortem link once ready.

oncall-elena: thanks everyone, handing off. :v:
